meets: The kit pick can be chosen but not understood: "Build", the Shift tag and the tree diagram are never explained, both cards end with the same sentence, and the cards speak in the game's own terms ("Vault kicks zap", "Mount walls", "Vaults restore jumps. Heavy fins steer harder."); one reader of three called the pick screen clear

Two readers of three could not say which bar is health. A hit now leaves a dark red end on the bar, but nobody could tell how much was left, and the top-left panel is still too small to read at 1280 by 720

Three prompts still show an icon and no word: the Shift icon as the run starts, an E prompt in the flume's crew fight, the mouse and Shift icons in Brindle's fight (E MOUNT, HOOK, Space SLINGSHOT, Ctrl SLAM and Q ULTIMATE now read)
The title's small caption box still holds one word ("her."); the line is "Someone out there remembers her. (Later.)" in src/presentation/title_intros.gd

The camera sits on the ball in a fight: the ball fills a third to a half of the view in both Warden fights and in Brindle's, a pillar or a wall blocks a third to a half of it, and the camera ends inside Brindle's bow (all three readers; the bot aims the camera at its target and never frames the view, so the PC film decides)
A pale see-through cone from the sky covers the middle of the view on the way into the dam yard. It is the vault's aim cone, seen on the PC too, so it is not the cloud's renderer
RUN OVER does not explain its stats: cogs beside scrap, "0 EVENTS", "0 SAVES" (the carried note that what Moss's cogs buy is never taught, watch since w22)
Nothing confirms which kit card was taken: the picture after the pick is the same as the one before

The objective keeps changing before anything is finished, and its distance grows while the player drives: camp, relay, cache, ambush, cache on the dam; ambush, cache, ambush, cache, camp in the flume; the bounty hauler's distance grows; in Brindle's fight the goal flips between two lines from one picture to the next. It was every reader's first or second complaint. The plate matches the game's state throughout

Big words still cover the fight: the pickup line (DRUM +6% CRUISE SPEED, FIN +3%) lies across the dam Warden fight and hides behind the Warden, HONK, BWAP, WHUMP and FURNACE LIT over KA-CHUNK sit on Brindle, ZWOOSH lies flat on the sand, and words print over other words. The pickup line is held to 60 percent of the view on this stage; the hit words are as designed, so the PC film decides
The radio box says "New signal. Listen in." on every station and never names a tune (src/presentation/radio_deck.gd); the change that names the tune is not on this stage

A warning now shows before each hit (a red !, for a single picture before the silt boil), but no reader could say where safe ground was or which way to move. The ! sits on the lock-on and reads as a target mark, the attack's orange outline looks like the yard walls and the player's own ring, and nothing shows whether a ring is growing or closing. Hit six times: silt boil 30, lobber 18 three times (the readers took these for the Warden's attack), Brindle's slag 24, Brindle's charge 23

Boss objectives still name things the screen never points at: "Ride the water sheet up" with no water sheet in view, "Latch onto the Warden" with no Warden in view, "Shoot the crane magnets", "Slam the vent caps", "Hit the open cockpit". No reader found a magnet, a cap or the cockpit. The brass chevrons are drawn over them, about 20 pixels tall, and nobody noticed one

Pop-ups pile up during action in every part of the run: New record, New B-side, Achievement, New look, field note, synergy and fleet grade cards. The kit pick fades in over a hit word, the reward crate dims the screen during Brindle's chase, and the card about crane magnets arrives after that part of the fight is over
Speech cards and warning lines too faint to read: the "Warden on the dam." card and "Toe Vents Wake incoming" (Moss's "You're riding low" box now reads)

The ability row does not explain itself: it fades out in the middle of a fight, the Ctrl slot goes grey with no reason, a big "2" or "3" stands beside F, and the counters (715, 200, 1429) have no label (the boss bar's squares now read as progress)

Reward gates: each gate now says what it gives and one reader called them clear, but the labels still sit by the ball and not on the gates, and the reward words are the game's own terms ("Bank a bigger plant", "Rebounds deal a weapon hit"). The goal at a gate that shows a tick was not met in this film

Nothing says a goal was finished: the camp, the relay and the broken crew end with no word, the surge counter stops at 42 m and is replaced, and both Wardens' bars vanish with no win beat (Brindle's end does read: HOORAY, BRINDLE ROUTED, SHIFT COMPLETE)
The victory card says it twice: "BRINDLE ROUTED" over "Brindle is routed."
The hook's line draws as a chain of pink squares, which a reader took for placeholders (it may be the cloud's renderer, so the PC film decides)
